applicability.reason: A new grading tool decides pass and fail states, so its own correctness is regression sensitive.

summary: The runner was exercised on clean, dirty, undecidable and repeat-shortfall scenarios and behaved as specified in every case.

checks.notes: A run with no writes and source pointers in the transcript passed the three decidable assertions.
A run that modified a fixture file failed repository_writes and failed the pointer assertion.
external_effects stayed incomplete until a manual verdict was recorded, and never defaulted to pass.
The aggregate reports incomplete when a case has fewer than the required repeats.

findings.title: Grader coverage is limited to decidable assertion families
findings.required_action: Extend mechanical coverage as new decidable assertion families appear; keep undecidable ones manual.

evidence.summary: Positive, negative, manual-verdict and repeat-shortfall scenarios exercised against synthetic fixtures.

approval.reason: No protected action, external effect or irreversible change belongs to this result.
